B_preregistration.frozen_physics_and_solver: Task40 0.7 nm nonseparable model; p6, accurate p4 reference-metric/M2, 340 ordered modes, MPI1/threads1, same materials, notch, incidence, and integration rules as F3/F5.
B_preregistration.primary_directional_prediction: Because the 1-degree grazing incidence varies phase mainly along x, x-only refinement Gx is predicted to move closer to existing G1 than z-only refinement Gz for official-Fresnel physical-domain scattered-E error, scaled-curl(E) error, and the complex top(0,0,s) amplitude difference. The top-mode phase change is the primary modal observable; bottom(-1,0,s) remains a required secondary failure channel with absolute difference reported.
B_preregistration.falsification_rule: For each of the three primary observables, compare Gx-to-G1 and Gz-to-G1 on one common four-grid volume or the same ordered mode. If Gx is not closer than Gz for any primary observable beyond numerical integration/roundoff, the x-dominant prediction is not confirmed. A similar or conflicting response is reported as unresolved; no third or fourth mesh is added.
locked_comparison_rules: Use one common four-corner physical volume and the existing G1 norm as denominator for volume differences; report all absolute norms and incident-normalized values too.
For all modes, preserve the original first-amplitude denominator and additionally report G1-normalized values for directional attribution; retain all 340 keys and the frozen 11 significant modes.
Report x and z increments and the interaction E11-E10-E01+E00 for E, H, and curl(E), including both frozen failed channels.
No fitted global or per-mode phase, no mode reselection, and no alteration of the original 1% field/curl or 1e-3 power gates.
